message: クサヤタイム
The next morning. We were suddenly summoned.

name: Helena
message: 「And so, 'Listen up, maggots! Today I'm introducing your new drill instructor!'」

name: Everyone
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Ria
message: 「You're pretty calm, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「I figured it'd be something like this」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have been designing your special training regimens for some time now, and I have recently been appointed to instruct you directly. It may only be for a short period, but I look forward to working with you」

name: Helena
message: 「No, Melilot. Here you're supposed to say, 'I am Gunnery Sergeant Melilot, your senior drill instructor! From now on you will speak only when spoken to!' right?」

name: Helena
message: 「After I showed you that video over and over again, how lamentable」

name: Melilot
message: 「Lament all you want!」

name: Ria
message: 「Wait, did you know about last night too, Sis...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ehe. Sor-ry. I just figured good little kids like you would go looking for Azel-chan」

name: Melilot
message: 「I wanted to verify your strength in actual combat conditions」

name: Misa
message: 「Um... Melilot-san, are you one of the Seven Demon Generals?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is merely what some demons call us on their own. It sounds terribly childish, so I dislike it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Flash of inspiration! How about one of the Seven Stars!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I dislike that too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gasp」
And then, after school. Once we finished our Student Council work, it was time for our one-hour special training.

name: Melilot
message: 「Starting today, I will have you train under the assumption that your numbers are reduced during battle」

name: Synn
message: 「Our numbers reduced... You don't mean」

name: Melilot
message: 「Your coordination is quite impressive, yet it seems you weaken rapidly the moment even one person drops out」
I couldn't help glancing over at Nanaka.

name: Melilot
message: 「The remaining two Demon Generals, Soltia and Virus, are powerful」

name: Synn
message: 「Just how strong are they?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Setting Soltia aside, I do not want to fight Virus」

name: Misa
message: 「To think even Melilot-san doesn't want to fight him……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is Virus-san really that strong!? I'm trembling in my boots」

name: Melilot
message: 「For you as you are now, even Soltia is a sufficient threat. Nine times out of ten, you would be defeated」

name: Melilot
message: 「Should a battle break out, you must assume there is a high probability someone will fall during the fight」

name: Melilot
message: 「If that happens, as you are now, you will undoubtedly lose. And they will show you no mercy」

name: Lolotte
message: 「T-Things got serious all of a sudden!」

name: Synn
message: 「No way……」
We instinctively looked at each other.
Up until now, we had made it this far without losing a single person. Even our enemies hadn't tried to take our lives.
But the enemies from here on out…….
And if the one we lost were Nanaka…….

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What're you lookin' at! Who do ya think I am」

name: Melilot
message: 「Therefore, until I give you permission, if you encounter them, do not engage in combat and flee immediately」

name: Synn
message: 「Run away?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Of course, patrolling the academy at night is completely out of the question」

name: Melilot
message: 「Do you understand」
The words of the person who had handed us our very first defeat carried heavy weight.

name: Synn
message: 「……Yes」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, I will explain the details of your training」
Melilot-san opened the thick book she was holding in her hands.
An eyeball spread across the entire page looked around at us.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-It just looked at me!」

name: Ria
message: 「W-What are you talking about, Lolotte-chan. There's no way a picture could move. Ahaha」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait…… it might actually be cute\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How?! Its skin is all green and slimy--it's gross!」

name: Synn
message: 「Moving pictures and talking dolls are basically the same thing」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't lump the great sage yours truly in with something like that」

name: Melilot
message: 「This is called an Artifact Creature, an existence given temporary life by infusing an inanimate object with magical power」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's alive?! Then, d-don't tell me--it's gonna jump right out of the book?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is correct. You will be fighting them starting now」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Seriously?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Their combat power is zero, though their speed is quite considerable」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, zero? If they are that weak, there is no sense of tension at all. How boring」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan, this isn't a game」

name: Melilot
message: 「Their combat power is zero, however, please be careful as they fire a foul-smelling mucus synthesized from kusaya components out of their mouths」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek! That is way too much tension! If I go home with a smell like that on me, what will Jeeves say?! Shiver, shudder」

name: Melilot
message: 「If it gets on your skin, the odor will not wash off for three days」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's way too terrifying...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will release them five at a time, so please defeat all of them」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah! Roger that!」
Melilot-san took something out of her pocket. It looked like an earphone.

name: Melilot
message: 「I will have everyone put these on」

name: Synn
message: 「Could these be... communicators?」

name: Melilot
message: 「There are two rules」

name: Melilot
message: 「First. During combat, anyone hit by the mucus must cease all combat actions at that moment and lie down on the ground」

name: Melilot
message: 「Second. During combat, anyone to whom I speak over that communicator and say 'You are eliminated' must do the same」

name: Synn
message: 「I have one question」

name: Melilot
message: 「What might that be?」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like we could still get covered in slime while we're lying down, though」

name: Misa
message: 「R-Right! That's a major problem! O-Of course, I'd already thought of a question like that myself!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please just accept it as an unfortunate disaster」

name: Everyone
message: 「Whaaaaaaaaaat?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, let us begin」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-We seriously cannot afford to lose this!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Burst forth!」
Five monsters were unleashed from the open pages!

name: Misa
message: 「Nooo, it stiiiiinks!」

name: Ria
message: 「It stinks, it stinks! It's so stinky my eyes are watering...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eeeek! And I work in customer service!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My nose is starting to go numb... Actually, it's kind of starting to smell nice... Ufufufu」

name: Synn
message: 「Get a hold of yourself, Lolotte!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, me too!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why is the great me caught up in this toooo?! It stiiiiinks!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ew. It stinks」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis, is that really the first thing you say right after showing up...」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, it's because it stinks\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Walking around smelling like this would disqualify me as a maiden!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What will Sebastian say... Shiver, shiver, tremble, tremble」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san! At least do something about us getting sprayed while we're lying down!」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's just how it's designed」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What kind of buggy game is this?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, it’s almost closing time. You’d better go straight home and wash up real good. Unless you actually like that smell, of course」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I’m going straight home without you telling me to. I can’t make any detours smelling like this」

name: Misa
message: 「Whether I smell or not, I wouldn’t make any detours!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, dismissed for today」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yugiri-san, please stay behind for a moment. It won’t take long」
